order_candidates.name: timestamp
order_candidates.reason: Chronological order is plausible only if time carries structure.

order_candidates.name: first_seen_pair
order_candidates.reason: Orders ties by relationship emergence; useful for churn surfaces.

order_candidates.name: degree_descending
order_candidates.reason: Topology-aligned order; tests whether hubs organize the signal.

order_candidates.name: group_then_time
order_candidates.reason: Only valid when canonical group labels exist and are allowed.

order_candidates.name: stable_id_or_alphabetic
order_candidates.reason: Arbitrary stable order; signal here is suspect unless explained as a proxy.

order_candidates.name: random_order
order_candidates.reason: Destroys order while preserving the event set.

order_candidates.name: silly_proxy_order
order_candidates.reason: Sort by a nonsense/proxy key such as string length or digit frequency to expose order artifacts.

order_candidates.name: timestamp_bucket_partial_order
order_candidates.reason: Preserve within-bucket simultaneity instead of imposing arbitrary tie order.

view_candidates.name: group_multilayer
view_candidates.reason: Use group/department layers when labels are canonical and available at analysis time.

view_candidates.name: partial_order_or_hyperedge
view_candidates.reason: Preserve simultaneity or higher-order events instead of serializing them.

view_candidates.name: relationship_graph
view_candidates.reason: Use graph adjacency and node/pair topology without forcing a total order.

view_candidates.name: relation_churn
view_candidates.reason: Use novelty, returning ties, lost ties, and neighbor turnover as the main surface.

view_candidates.name: temporal_total_order
view_candidates.reason: Use timestamp order as a primary sequence only if it beats order-control nulls.

dataset.notes: SocioPatterns workplace contacts with matching department metadata.

interpretation_guardrails: A candidate view separating from controls earns a larger run; it is not a discovery by itself.
A control-dominates result means the enforced structure is probably introducing an artifact.
Ambiguous ties should be tested downstream in parallel or treated as unresolved.
Map any surfaced anomalies back to canonical events/entities before naming them.

recommendation.reason: Only a subset of assessed candidate views separated from controls.
